prop:monotone_represents.scope: Shared varying-width Network evaluated with an arbitrary monotone scalar activation, nonnegative signed weights, and optional nonnegative affine output map.

prop:icnn_convex.scope: Generic convex monotone scalar activation on the shared varying-width Network; first affine weights unrestricted, later weights and final affine readout nonnegative. Actual coordinatewise ConvexOn over the whole input space.

prop:bellman.scope: Finite discounted MDP with normalized transitions, real rewards and discount in [0,1): Bellman and randomized-policy contractions, Banach fixed-point existence/uniqueness, value comparison for every stationary randomized policy, pure greedy optimality and interpretation as the convergent expected reward series.

thm:shapley_bellman.scope: Finite-horizon layered stochastic game with actual randomized policies, normalized transitions, nonnegative discounts, constructed pure optimal selector, saddle inequalities at every layered state, and uniqueness of the Bellman recursion. Finite common nonempty action type; state-dependent actions represented by duplicate actions.

thm:relu_net_game_value.scope: Natural dependent randomized continuation strategies on the same varying-width Network. Actual expected normalized/discounted policy payoffs satisfy saddle inequalities against every opponent and equal the original signed network values. Includes ungated signed affine readout. Nonnegative split weights and positive fan-in are explicit.

lem:support_properties.scope: Actual supremum support functions of arbitrary nonempty compact sets: convexity, positive homogeneity, Minkowski addition, convex hull of union, and uniqueness for compact convex sets. No finite-polytope restriction.

prop:newton_calculus.scope: Constructive finite max-affine polynomial with real slopes/intercepts; actual Newton convex hull max/add identities and lifted support representation.

thm:split_tropical_rational.scope: Constructive finite max-affine representation of both entire shared Network split heads, actual evaluators and difference recovery, nonnegative slopes, zero intercepts and positive homogeneity for bias-free networks. Signed affine output wrapper included.

thm:monotone_nonneg_gradients.scope: Nonnegative directional derivative at differentiable points; no subdifferential theorem.

cor:minkowski_propagation.scope: Constructive polynomial propagation and actual Newton hull addition/maximum calculus checked; the full weighted layer-by-layer Minkowski set recursion is not separately packaged.

prop:subdifferential_face.scope: Actual support function of a nonempty finite convex hull: full subgradient inequality iff membership in its maximizing face, and actual Frechet differentiability iff that face is a singleton.

cor:polytopes_nonneg.scope: Actual Newton convex hull has nonnegative coordinates when all generating slopes do; constructive entire-network split representation supplies those slopes.

thm:vertices_gradients.scope: Actual mathlib extremePoints of any nonempty finite convex hull equal exactly the gradients attained by its support function. Includes construction of exposing directions and true local Frechet derivatives, without generic-position assumptions.

prop:validity_recovery.scope: Full varying-width shared network with arbitrary scalar and pair activations and biases. Scalar difference preservation implies full network recovery; nonnegative pair output is proved separately under explicit nonnegative parameter/input/activation assumptions.

thm:mixing_recovery.scope: Full varying-width network eta-mixing recovery for every real eta; nonnegative streams when eta is in [0,1] and parameters/input pairs are nonnegative.

thm:mixing_convex_extreme.scope: Convexity in split input pair proved; composition with an arbitrary convex input splitting is not packaged as a theorem.

cor:dc_split_endpoint.scope: The eta=1 entire network is definitionally identified with the proved convex monotone split; recovery and convexity proved separately with explicit assumptions.

prop:stream_properties.scope: Both heads of arbitrary-width biased split networks, nonnegative split weights, Jensen form of convexity.

thm:split_correct.scope: Entire finite ReLU network with arbitrary varying widths and split biases; output-identity convention. Source tail theorem follows by choosing the corresponding tail network.

thm:freg_validity.scope: Scalar entropy/softplus regularized pair recovery; general convex regularizers and complete network induction not encoded.

cor:fsoft.scope: Entire shared Network soft pair decomposition recovers the Softplus forward pass; scalar entropy optimizer proved separately. Full game SPNE not asserted.

thm:shift_forward.scope: Whole-network common shift propagated by Wp+Wn. Canonical sign parts have Wp+Wn=abs(W), checked scalarwise.

thm:delta_connection.scope: Whole-network sensitivity complementarity equals the actual absolute weight product for canonical split weights. Actual head derivatives are identified at strict gates; the selected-mask algebra also holds without differentiability.

thm:closed_formula_shift.scope: Complete varying-width shifted backward algorithm, canonical sign-split weights, strict original preactivations, arbitrary shift parameters and output row. Every Q is explicitly defined with original prefix, one minimum, and a linear absolute-weight tail; its actual Frechet derivative and the suffix shift products are proved. Algorithmic shifted sensitivities are not claimed to be derivatives of input-dependent re-centered functions.

prop:conv_correct.scope: Arbitrary rectangular linear operator algebra applies after flattening convolution; tensor/convolution index correspondence not encoded.

lem:linear_chunk.scope: Affine reconstruction, including arbitrary rectangular linear maps and split biases.

prop:maxpool_correct.scope: Exact finite nonempty max-pooling split identity.

thm:cnn_split_correct.scope: Actual topologically ordered shared-node computation graph, all-node difference recovery and nonnegative split outputs with optional common re-centering. Additive max/affine graphs without re-centering have convex monotone streams. Concrete convolution tensor indexing is represented by flattened finite affine operations.

ptnb:thm:gradient.scope: Explicit discounted sign-labelled finite path occupation difference equals the actual shared Network Frechet derivative on a strict ReLU cell, with positive fan-in. Local cemetery-inclusive transition normalization and positivity are checked. This covers the gradient/occupation identity for the stated gate policy, not a global SPNE/equilibrium existence theorem.

ptnb:thm:lrp-recovery.scope: Entire shared Network alpha-beta backward recurrence from actual weights and activations equals signed discounted explicit paths for arbitrary output relevance. Positive epsilon and nonnegative alpha/beta give valid nonnegative path quantities. Recovery for the stated anchor policies is proved; global game SPNE and the epsilon=0 degenerate convention are not included.

ptnb:thm:deriv-occ.scope: Explicit discounted sign-labelled finite path occupation difference equals the actual shared Network Frechet derivative on a strict ReLU cell, with positive fan-in. Local cemetery-inclusive transition normalization and positivity are checked. This covers the gradient/occupation identity for the stated gate policy, not a global SPNE/equilibrium existence theorem.

ptnb:thm:ab-recovery.scope: Entire shared Network alpha-beta backward recurrence from actual weights and activations equals signed discounted explicit paths for arbitrary output relevance. Positive epsilon and nonnegative alpha/beta give valid nonnegative path quantities. Recovery for the stated anchor policies is proved; global game SPNE and the epsilon=0 degenerate convention are not included.

ptnb:lem:noisy-gate-dual.scope: Binary entropy/softplus variational identity and unique sigmoid optimizer; general regularizers and probit/Gaussian alternatives not formalized.

ptnb:thm:softplus-forward.scope: Entire shared Network soft pair decomposition recovers the Softplus forward pass; scalar entropy optimizer proved separately. Full game SPNE not asserted.

ptnb:thm:softplus-gradient.scope: Actual full varying-width Softplus network derivative equals discounted sign-path occupations with sigmoid stopping and positive fan-in; same Network parameters/evaluator as the ReLU development. Positive temperature and nonnegative split weights for stochastic interpretation. Global equilibrium existence is not included.

prop:gradient_blindness.scope: For actual strict ReLU network input, if every connected nonzero-edge path contains an inactive neuron, that input/output derivative coordinate vanishes on an open neighborhood with a fixed trace.

lem:split_backward_recursion.scope: Actual strict-branch Fréchet derivative, explicit four Jacobian blocks and genuine two-contribution positive/negative partial pullbacks; source masked-matrix notation is represented equivalently by branch-selected linear maps.

prop:sensitivity_mass.scope: Whole-network sensitivity complementarity equals the actual absolute weight product for canonical split weights. Actual head derivatives are identified at strict gates; the selected-mask algebra also holds without differentiability.

cor:backward_invariant.scope: The difference of the actual implemented shifted unified sensitivities is the genuine original MLP derivative under strict gates, with the required one-half factor; the split Jacobian reconstructs the original one.

prop:posynomial_representation.scope: Constructive nonempty finite ordinary polynomial witnesses for positive arithmetic/max/product expressions, evaluated on the nonnegative input orthant, with actual nonnegative MvPolynomial coefficients.

thm:multiplicative_split.scope: Actual shared-node arithmetic DAG, signed affine/residual/max/product operations, exact rank-two max/product split and nonnegative-orthant monotonicity. Explicit nonempty finite lists of ordinary MvPolynomials with nonnegative coefficients represent each stream. Concrete tensor indexing is a flattening boundary.

ptnb:lem:kl-legendre-fenchel.scope: Finite nonempty actions, positive reference mass at every action, real scores and positive temperature: actual reference-KL objective maximum and unique tilted optimizer, allowing candidate policies with zero coordinates. Extended minus-infinity scores and zero reference support are not included.

ptnb:prop:attn-value-policy.scope: Exact reference-weighted Value-routing KL optimizer and uniqueness with strictly positive reference and contribution masses; the source zero-contribution/outside-option cases are not included.

ptnb:thm:attn-ab-recovery.scope: Fixed nonnegative row-stochastic attention matrix A, signed Value projection with bias, and arbitrary shared MLP backbone. Composite affine map, its actual derivative and signed probability/discount factorization recover full alpha-beta recurrence for positive epsilon and nonnegative alpha,beta. Query/Key derivatives and global SPNE not asserted.

ptnb:lem:bc-chain-rule.scope: Exact arbitrary finite trajectory overlap dynamic-programming identity for nonnegative kernels. Fixed finite state type; layered graphs can be represented with a common finite state space.

ptnb:lem:bc-monotone.scope: Substochastic geometric kernel and one-step weighted-overlap mass contraction; source multi-layer formulation is obtained by iteration but not separately packaged.

ptnb:lem:hellinger-backward-correctness.scope: Full finite-path overlap equals geometric-kernel DP; implementation-level backward code is not verified.

ptnb:rem:rg-natural-equivalence.scope: Corrected finite-law coarsening inequalities, exact reindexing with an erase/recover inverse, and normalized explicit absorption-history counterexample. Equality for the model survivor graph requires its stated reconstruction property.

ptnb:thm:per-pixel.scope: Exact nonnegative finite trajectory disagreement, terminal-fibre attribution, total equals squared Hellinger. Model-specific pixel-index encoding not required.

ptnb:thm:conditioned-survival.scope: Normalization identity and mass overlap bound; strictly positive survival Doob kernels normalize, stay nonnegative, and telescope to conditional path law; overlap endpoint equivalences proved for normalized finite laws. Source zero-survival pruning/layer-specific cemetery encoding not packaged.
